subject: Mental Models
title: Porter's Five Forces
description: A micro-lesson that makes Porter's Five Forces usable.

hook.text: Two restaurants serve identical food. One is surrounded by five competitors. The other has the only kitchen in town.

buildup.text: Michael Porter identified five forces that shape industry profitability: rivalry, new entrants, substitutes.

twist.text: Airline industries score poorly on all five forces. Pharmaceutical companies score well.

climax.text: Before entering any competitive arena, map the five forces. A brilliant player in a bad structure still struggles.

punchline.text: The game's structure matters more than your skill.

quiz.question: How many forces did Michael Porter identify?
